functions.name: clamp
documentation: Clamps a value to the inclusive range defined by the minimum and maximum values.

arguments.name: value
documentation: The value to clamp.

arguments.name: minimum
documentation: The inclusive lower bound.

arguments.name: maximum
documentation: The inclusive upper bound.

returns.name: clampedValue
documentation: The clamped value.

functions.name: isfinite
documentation: Returns whether a value is finite.

arguments.name: value
documentation: The value to inspect.

returns.name: finite
documentation: True if the value is neither infinite nor NaN; otherwise false.

functions.name: isinf
documentation: Returns whether a value is positive or negative infinity.

arguments.name: value
documentation: The value to inspect.

returns.name: infinite
documentation: True if the value is positive or negative infinity; otherwise false.

functions.name: isnan
documentation: Returns whether a value is NaN.

arguments.name: value
documentation: The value to inspect.

returns.name: nan
documentation: True if the value is NaN; otherwise false.

functions.name: lerp
documentation: Linearly interpolates between two values.

arguments.name: startValue
documentation: The value returned when the interpolation amount is 0.

arguments.name: endValue
documentation: The value returned when the interpolation amount is 1.

arguments.name: amount
documentation: The interpolation amount. Values outside [0, 1] extrapolate beyond the two values.

returns.name: interpolatedValue
documentation: The interpolated value.

functions.name: normalize
documentation: Returns the relative position of a value within a range, where the minimum maps to 0 and the maximum maps to 1.

arguments.name: value
documentation: The value to normalize.

arguments.name: minimum
documentation: The value that maps to 0.

arguments.name: maximum
documentation: The value that maps to 1.

returns.name: normalizedValue
documentation: The normalized value. Values outside the input range produce results outside [0, 1].

functions.name: remap
documentation: Maps a value from one range to the corresponding position in another range.

arguments.name: value
documentation: The value to map.

arguments.name: sourceMinimum
documentation: The lower endpoint of the source range.

arguments.name: sourceMaximum
documentation: The upper endpoint of the source range.

arguments.name: destinationMinimum
documentation: The lower endpoint of the destination range.

arguments.name: destinationMaximum
documentation: The upper endpoint of the destination range.

returns.name: remappedValue
documentation: The mapped value. Values outside the source range are extrapolated beyond the destination range.

functions.name: round
documentation: Rounds a value to the specified number of decimal places, with halfway values rounded away from zero.

arguments.name: value
documentation: The value to round.

arguments.name: decimalPlaces
documentation: The number of decimal places to preserve. Negative values round to positions left of the decimal point.

returns.name: roundedValue
documentation: The rounded value.

functions.name: saturate
documentation: Clamps a value to the inclusive range [0, 1].

arguments.name: value
documentation: The value to clamp.

returns.name: saturatedValue
documentation: The value clamped to the inclusive range [0, 1].

functions.name: sign
documentation: Returns -1 for negative values, 0 for zero, and 1 for positive values.

arguments.name: value
documentation: The value whose sign will be returned.

returns.name: sign
documentation: The sign of the value.

functions.name: wrap
documentation: Wraps a value into the half-open range [minimum, maximum).

arguments.name: value
documentation: The value to wrap.

arguments.name: minimum
documentation: The inclusive lower bound of the range.

arguments.name: maximum
documentation: The exclusive upper bound of the range.

returns.name: wrapped
documentation: The wrapped value, greater than or equal to minimum and less than maximum. If minimum equals maximum, returns minimum.
